about_detail:
ZipCloak - zip file obfuscation tool


Website: https://coralhymn.com
Source Code: https://github.com/coralhymn/ZipCloak
Copyright: coralhymn | 琴海奶油
License: GPL-2.0

Version: 1.0.0
Function: Obfuscate specified file types to make them appear as folders

Instructions:
[Obfuscate Mode]
1. Select source folder and output ZIP file location in the Obfuscate tab
2. Choose file extensions to obfuscate
3. Click Start Obfuscation to generate encrypted ZIP file
[Restore Mode]
1. Select the obfuscated ZIP file in the Restore tab
2. Set output directory and click Start Restore (do not select root directory, create a subdirectory instead)
[Configuration File]
On first run, a configuration file zipcloak_config.json will be automatically generated in the application root directory. Do not delete this file as it stores your settings and will be loaded on next run.
File extensions added in Obfuscate Mode will be saved in the configuration file. To remove added extensions, delete this file (or modify the JSON file directly).

This project is modified from my personal project [https://github.com/CoralHymn/RWMP2_Decryptor]
If you need to decrypt files encrypted with [RWMP2], please use the dedicated version above instead of this tool.
If you're interested in this project, feel free to give me a Star on GitHub, which will be a great motivation for me.

Notes:
Do not use this tool to obfuscate important files. I am not responsible for any losses.
I have not conducted in-depth testing. Please backup important files when using this tool to prevent data loss.
